introduction: Explore the ruins of Turolopolis: recover the Ring of Glory's badges, strengthen a bloodsaber, help the city's visitors and confront Willem's legacy.
orientation: Lothrell, the sorrowful elf in the foothills outside the city, can tell you about Turolopolis and the Ring of Glory. Ask him about turol, story, spell and favor.

The five statues in the plaza lead to hostile, imprisoned heroes. Rub a statue to enter a mirrored chamber. Recovering a badge directly means defeating its bearer and looting it. Each colored badge also serves as a key, so keep the ones you need for travel before offering them.
Lothrell asks for five different Glory Badges: brown, green, blue, red and black. His reward includes a lesser bloodsaber. Sprecken can tell you how Kurtukr could improve that blade.
Corwyck studies the city's altered animals. The drow emissary longs for news of his people, while an inventive minotaur experiments with blue ooze in the sewers. Ask them about their troubles.
The minotaur carries the letter the emissary wants, but leaves after receiving his ooze. These two requests may take separate visits, another reset or materials obtained from another adventurer.
A weary slave seeks proof of Willem's death. Delivering the requested skull earns his reward; the journal records that exchange.

Bring the requested items loose in your inventory. Gifts and trades can supply them. Each accepted request remains in your journal after its materials are spent; gathering every ingredient yourself is optional.

contacts.name: Lothrell

stories.title: Corwyck: bring the unicorn horn
stories.summary: Corwyck believes a unicorn horn will help him treat the fountain. Bring him the horn from the city's frenzied unicorn; he offers an iron key before leaving to begin his work.

steps.hint: The mutated unicorn can be found in the stables carrying this horn. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.

steps.text: Complete Corwyck: bring the unicorn horn
steps.hint: Bring the requested materials together and offer them to the quest giver.

stories.title: Lothrell: honour the five heroes
stories.summary: Lothrell wants his companions' five colored Glory Badges for a memorial. Their imprisoned bearers are hostile; defeat them to recover their badges, or obtain matching badges from another adventurer. Bring all five together for his lesser bloodsaber.

steps.hint: Ballic wears the brown badge in a mirrored room reached by RUB statue at the northernmost rogue statue in the plaza. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.
Chlyridia wears the green badge in a mirrored room reached by RUB statue at the staff-bearing woman just north of the plaza’s centre. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.
Kalmidor wears the blue badge in a mirrored room reached by RUB statue at the Mountain Dwarf in the centre of the plaza. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.
Gorma wears the red badge in a mirrored room reached by RUB statue at the battle-ready woman at the southern end of the row. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.
Okhell wears the black badge in a mirrored room reached by RUB statue at the cloaked figure just south of the plaza’s centre. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.

steps.text: Complete Lothrell: honour the five heroes
steps.hint: Bring the requested materials together and offer them to the quest giver.

stories.title: The drow emissary: recover the timeworn letter
stories.summary: The imprisoned drow emissary wants news of his people. Bring him the timeworn letter carried by the inventive minotaur; he rewards you with a blue ribbon laced with silver thread.

steps.hint: The minotaur begins in a dead end of the sewers carrying the letter. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.

steps.text: Complete The drow emissary: recover the timeworn letter
steps.hint: Bring the requested materials together and offer them to the quest giver.

stories.title: Kurtukr: strengthen the bloodsaber
stories.summary: Kurtukr can strengthen a lesser bloodsaber using the caecilia's stinger. Lothrell's reward is one way to obtain the blade; one supplied by another adventurer also works.

steps.text: Optional earlier route: honour Lothrell’s five heroes
steps.hint: Lothrell rewards the five badges with a lesser bloodsaber. You can also obtain the blade from another adventurer.
Obtain Lothrell’s lesser blade or a supplied copy. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.

steps.text: Carry the sewer caecilia’s exact stinger
steps.hint: The sewer caecilia can be found in a smelly tunnel with the hidden stinger. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.
Bring the requested materials together and offer them to the quest giver.

stories.title: The minotaur: supply the blue ooze
stories.summary: The inventive minotaur needs a lump of blue ooze for his horn-wrapping experiments. He shares the finished gauze wrappings, then leaves to try them.

steps.text: Carry the exact lump of blue ooze
steps.hint: Several blue oozes start in a corner of the Plaza of Statues, but only one placement carries this lump. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.

steps.text: Complete The minotaur: supply the blue ooze
steps.hint: Bring the requested materials together and offer them to the quest giver.

stories.title: The slave: deliver Willem’s named skull
stories.summary: A weary slave has gathered a reward for proof of Willem's death. Bring him Willem's skull so he can spread the news.

steps.hint: Willem begins in his bedchamber with the hidden named skull and following companions. Carry this item loose in your inventory for the offering.
